handoverLog.doing: Sesi A (s1): tahap 0–3 berjalan. Proyek Remotion disalin dari EP05 project (tanpa out/, public/audio, src/episodes) ke EP09/project, node_modules ikut tersalin. 26 GLB laut disalin ke project/public/models/polyfork (angler-one-base, one-person-submarine-0b9d14, jellyfish-base, moon-jellyfish-0fa43c, octopus-base, sea-turtle-base, dolphin-base, reef-shark-base, exploration-rover-7afd91, comm-satellite-fdc2cd, mountaineer-13df29, karst-limestone-peak-ee1b76, fumarole-vent-8280ba, coral-pinnacle-0d9756, aquascape-rock-arch-48bf5e, sea-anemone-base, sunken-fishing-boat-061c70, small-fishing-boat-4ac0e3, scuba-diver-bdd1c8, lava-rock-pile-d56d19, gorgonian-sea-fan-aa3c45, sea-urchin-base, astronaut-explorer-323482, field-rock-5e37c6, stingray-base, moray-eel-base). Style dipilih: ABYSSFORGE 3D (style/STYLE_DECISION.md terisi; cover-reference.png). src/episodes/abyss/bodies.tsx = salinan bodies EP05 (Moon, Earth, StarSphere, LabelPlate, Arrow). Riset dijalankan subagent → research/SOURCE_REGISTER.md (cek isinya; bila kosong, riset ulang).
handoverLog.next: Selesaikan riset (verifikasi: zona 200/1000/4000/6000 m, +1 atm per 10 m, Challenger Deep ~10.935 m vs Everest 8.849 m, Seabed 2030 % terpeta terbaru, 12 orang di Bulan vs jumlah orang ke Challenger Deep (kemungkinan >12, jangan klaim 'lebih sedikit'), ~76% hewan bercahaya MBARI, 71% Bumi laut). Lalu tahap 4: docs/ART_DIRECTION.md, docs/SCRIPT.md (195–210 kata, 'Audira' di hook/outro, ramah anak), docs/STORYBOARD.md (8 adegan: Bulan/astronaut hook → permukaan 71% + kapal → turun per zona (lumba-lumba/penyu, hiu, ubur-ubur, ikan pemancing) → tekanan + kapal selam → palung vs Everest (karst peak) → kenapa sulit dipetakan (sonar kapal, % terpeta) → makhluk bercahaya → outro), docs/ASSET_MANIFEST.md, docs/SHOTLIST.md. Root.tsx: hapus Moon + PenggantiGibran, daftarkan AbyssPreview/AbyssFinal. Pola kode: tiru EP05 src/episodes/moon (MoonFilm.tsx, scenes.tsx SceneOut, Hud.tsx Card, timeline.ts). Finish: CYBER_NEON_VOID exp 1.15 env 0.35 ao; pasang <QaProbe/> di dalam FilmScene children. Kit abyssforge: WaterColumn3D (salju laut, plankton, god-ray), Jellyfish3D, Lanternmaw3D, palette ABYSS_PALETTE. TEMP ke F: (C: sisa 1 GB). Kunci render F:/AUDIRA-EPISODES/_render.lock sebelum render final.

handoverLog.doing: Sesi A selesai (tahap 0–4). Riset di research/SOURCE_REGISTER.md (angka: >70% laut, rata-rata 3.682 m, zona 200/1.000/4.000/6.000 m, +1 atm/10 m, Challenger Deep 10.935 m, Everest 8.849 m → puncak ±2 km di bawah air, >1.000× tekanan, 28,7% terpeta (NOAA Apr 2026, VO '29 persen'), 76% hewan bercahaya, Bulan 384.400 km). Klaim 'lebih sedikit orang ke palung dari ke Bulan' SALAH, tidak dipakai. Style ABYSSFORGE 3D, engine Remotion+R3F (style/STYLE_DECISION.md). Naskah final audio/vo.txt 212 kata, 8 baris s1–s8 (Audira di hook & outro). docs ART_DIRECTION/SCRIPT/STORYBOARD/ASSET_MANIFEST selesai. Proyek project/ disalin dari EP05 (node_modules ada), Root.tsx sudah mendaftarkan AbyssPreview/AbyssFinal dari src/episodes/abyss/AbyssFilm.tsx (FILE BELUM DIBUAT — wajib export AbyssFilm + ABYSS_SECONDS), PenggantiGibran dihapus. Sudah ada: src/episodes/abyss/bodies.tsx (Moon, Earth, StarSphere, LabelPlate, Arrow dari EP05) dan src/episodes/abyss/ocean.tsx (waterAt, WaterFog, MarineSnow, GodRays, Seabed, Glow). 26 GLB laut di public/models/polyfork.
handoverLog.next: Sesi B tahap 5–8: (6) VO: audira_generate_voiceover text=isi audio/vo.txt, outputPath project/public/audio/vo.wav, wordsPath project/public/audio/vo-words.json; npm run vo -- public/audio/vo.wav. (8) contact sheet 540x960 + audit:visual + juri buta + draft/THEME_CHECK.md.
